CLINICAL FEATURES OF HYPERGLYCEMIA IN A CHILD
Clinical Features
- Persistent dehydration with glycosuria
- Transient diabetes is suspected among infants with wasting or intra-uterine
growth restriction who develop hyperglycaemia whilst on enteral feeds.
